description: Migrate a Java inventory service to Optional and streams: findItem and mostExpensive return Optional<Item> with the nullable scanner input guarded by Optional.ofNullable, getStockLabel is built from Optional.map/orElse instead of null checks and nested ternaries, the loops become filter/map/findFirst/sum pipelines, and no null comparison remains in InventoryService.java.

criteria: InventoryService.java returns Optional<Item> from findItem (guarding the nullable scanner sku with Optional.ofNullable and flatMapping into a stream-based lookup) and from mostExpensive, builds getStockLabel with Optional.map(...).orElse(...) producing the same three strings as before, computes the stock total with mapToLong/sum and the category names with filter/map/collect, and contains no '== null' or '!= null' comparison, with the README untouched.
